newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Mirabell Int'l offers 60 mln shrs at HK$1.22 ea.
newsitem.headline: HK Mirabell Int'l offers 60 mln shrs at HK$1.22 ea.

text.p: Shoe distributor Mirabell International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was offering 60 million new shares at HK$1.22 per share in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The weighted-average and fully-diluted prospective price-to-earnings multiples are expected to be 6.1 times and 7.1 times, respectively, the company's listing document said.
The dividend yield for the issue is seen at six percent and its adjusted net asset value was HK$0.521 per share. Market capitalisation is about HK$292.8 million.
Nikko Securities (Asia) Ltd and Tai Fook Securities are sponsors of the issue.
Mirabell said it forecast net profit after taxation but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$39 million for the year ending February 28, 1997.
The company said it posted profit of HK$24.9 million on turnover of HK$283.19 million for the year ended Feburary 28, 1996, against HK$23.7 million on HK$195.63 million in 1995.
Mirabell had a profit of HK$12.98 million on turnover of HK$106.36 million for the four months period to June 30, 1996.
Dealing in shares is scheduled to commence on December 6 and the public offering will be from Monday to Thursday.

Among the net proceeds of HK$63 million, HK$19 million will be used to finance the establishment of new outlets in Hong Kong, HK$15 million to fund purchase of premises and centralise warehouses and administrative office in Hong Kong.
Another HK$10 million is earmarked for repaying bank borrowing and the remaining HK$19 million will serve as general working capital, the company said.
Mirabell currently has more than 40 outlets in Hong Kong and Macau to distribute footware including famous brands such as Timberland, Dr. Martens, and Florsheim.
